        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display settings\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_columns\", None)\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.width\", 100)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart styling\n",
        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Student Performance Analysis\")\n",
        "print(\"Libraries imported successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Pandas version:\", pd.__version__)\n",
        "print(\"NumPy version:\", np.__version__)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# Make the results reproducible\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Generate sample records for 120 students\n",
        "n = 120\n",
        "\n",
        "study_hours = np.round(np.random.uniform(1, 8, n), 1)\n",
        "attendance = np.round(np.random.uniform(55, 100, n), 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Scores are influenced by study hours and attendance,\n",
        "# with some random variation\n",
        "noise = np.random.normal(0, 9, n)\n",
        "\n",
        "math_score = np.clip(\n",
        "    25 + study_hours * 5 + attendance * 0.25 + noise,\n",
        "    0, 100\n",
        ").round(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "science_score = np.clip(\n",
        "    20 + study_hours * 5.5 + attendance * 0.3\n",
        "    + np.random.normal(0, 10, n),\n",
        "    0, 100\n",
        ").round(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "english_score = np.clip(\n",
        "    30 + study_hours * 4.5 + attendance * 0.25\n",
        "    + np.random.normal(0, 11, n),\n",
        "    0, 100\n",
        ").round(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Student_ID\": [f\"STU{i:03d}\" for i in range(1, n + 1)],\n",
        "    \"Study_Hours\": study_hours,\n",
        "    \"Attendance_Percent\": attendance,\n",
        "    \"Math_Score\": math_score,\n",
        "    \"Science_Score\": science_score,\n",
        "    \"English_Score\": english_score\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Average_Score\"] = df[\n",
        "    [\"Math_Score\", \"Science_Score\", \"English_Score\"]\n",
        "].mean(axis=1).round(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Performance_Level\"] = pd.cut(\n",
        "    df[\"Average_Score\"],\n",
        "    bins=[-1, 39, 59, 79, 100],\n",
        "    labels=[\"Needs Improvement\", \"Fair\", \"Good\", \"Excellent\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Dataset created successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Number of students:\", len(df))\n",
        "display(df.head(10))"
      ],

      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# 1. Subject-wise performance\n",
        "subject_columns = [\"Math_Score\", \"Science_Score\", \"English_Score\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "subject_summary = df[subject_columns].agg(\n",
        "    [\"mean\", \"median\", \"min\", \"max\", \"std\"]\n",
        ").T\n",
        "\n",
        "subject_summary.columns = [\n",
        "    \"Mean\", \"Median\", \"Minimum\", \"Maximum\", \"Std_Deviation\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"SUBJECT-WISE PERFORMANCE\")\n",
        "display(subject_summary.round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Performance-level distribution\n",
        "print(\"\\nPERFORMANCE LEVEL DISTRIBUTION\")\n",
        "performance_counts = df[\"Performance_Level\"].value_counts()\n",
        "display(performance_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Attendance and study-hour analysis\n",
        "print(\"\\nATTENDANCE SUMMARY\")\n",
        "display(df[\"Attendance_Percent\"].describe().round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nSTUDY HOURS SUMMARY\")\n",
        "display(df[\"Study_Hours\"].describe().round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Top 10 students by average score\n",
        "print(\"\\nTOP 10 STUDENTS BY AVERAGE SCORE\")\n",
        "top_students = df.nlargest(10, \"Average_Score\")[\n",
        "    [\"Student_ID\", \"Study_Hours\", \"Attendance_Percent\",\n",
        "     \"Average_Score\", \"Performance_Level\"]\n",
        "]\n",
        "display(top_students)"
      ],

        "\n",
        "# Chart 1: Average score by subject\n",
        "subject_means = df[subject_columns].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "sns.barplot(x=subject_means.index, y=subject_means.values)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Average Score by Subject\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Subject\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average Score\")\n",
        "plt.ylim(0, 100)\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=15)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart 2: Distribution of average scores\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "sns.histplot(df[\"Average_Score\"], bins=15, kde=True)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribution of Student Average Scores\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Average Score\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Students\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart 3: Attendance versus average score\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "sns.regplot(\n",
        "    data=df,\n",
        "    x=\"Attendance_Percent\",\n",
        "    y=\"Average_Score\",\n",
        "    scatter_kws={\"alpha\": 0.65}\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Attendance vs Average Score\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Attendance (%)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average Score\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Select numerical columns for correlation analysis\n",
        "numeric_columns = [\n",
        "    \"Study_Hours\",\n",
        "    \"Attendance_Percent\",\n",
        "    \"Math_Score\",\n",
        "    \"Science_Score\",\n",
        "    \"English_Score\",\n",
        "    \"Average_Score\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "correlation_matrix = df[numeric_columns].corr()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(9, 6))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    correlation_matrix,\n",
        "    annot=True,\n",
        "    cmap=\"coolwarm\",\n",
        "    fmt=\".2f\",\n",
        "    vmin=-1,\n",
        "    vmax=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Correlation Between Student Metrics\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Correlation with Average Score:\")\n",
        "display(\n",
        "    correlation_matrix[\"Average_Score\"]\n",
        "    .drop(\"Average_Score\")\n",
        "    .sort_values(ascending=False)\n",
        "    .to_frame(\"Correlation\")\n",
        "    .round(3)\n",
        ")"
      ],

            "application/javascript": [
              "\n",
              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {}
        },

          "output_type": "display_data",

            ]
